name: Full Crew
overview: Full cast and crew, audio-type browsing, stats, studio pages, and rotating bumpers
description: Fetches complete TMDB cast and crew for movies and series, groups people by department, and shows them in a polished accordion on Jellyfin Web item detail pages. Includes an Audio Tracks browser for commentary and other special audio, break bumpers, Library Stats, studio pages, and a playback character rail.

versions.changelog: 1.8.2: Startup hardening so Full Crew cannot take Jellyfin down.
1.8.1: Episode stills hide the play badge — click the thumbnail to play.
1.8.0: Audio Tracks browser — commentary, descriptions, dubs, and other labeled extras across the whole library.
